chunks: And hearkens to its Lord and is dutiful,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for creation to 'hearken' and be 'dutiful' to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as the moment of ultimate acceptance (ḥuqūq) by all created beings, reflecting the cosmic order of submission (islām) to the Divine Will. It underscores the theological principle that obedience is not merely a choice but an inherent reality of creation, culminating in the Day of Judgment where every soul acknowledges its Lord.
